newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt in pact with India's Cadila.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt in pact with India's Cadila.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc. said Tuesday it signed a five-year sales and marketing pact with Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd. of India.
The alliance is expected to produce $150 million in annual sales by 2002, the St. Louis-based company said.
Under the pact, Mallinckrodt and Cadila will jointly manufacture, market, distribute, research and develop various products in the United States, India and other countries.
"Technology development and international business development are central to Mallinckrodt's integrated growth plan," said Mallinckrodt Chairman C. Ray Holman.

"This partnership with Cadila, which has strong market positions in India, Russia and Africa and a solid technology base in pharmaceuticals and hospital products, will give us a platform for growth in India as well as other important Asia Pacific and global markets," Holman said.
The five-year pact is renewable, the company said.

Mallinckrodt did not disclose specific products or product lines to be incorporated in the agreement, but the companies said in a joint statement they expect their medical products, pharmaceuticals and laboratory chemicals businesses to benefit from the pact.
Mallinckrodt's stock was unchanged at $39 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
